liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.label: Import artifact
liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.outcome: Resolve an admitted source reference or staged upload and report a governed import observation. When an authorized sidecar or embedded caption track is explicitly requested and observed for the exact immutable source version, the result may include its track identity, source timebase and any explicit mapping, language and format when known, conversion or alignment uncertainty, and provenance; this does not alter source media or register a caption as an artifact. optionalSemanticObservations.when: An authorized sidecar or embedded caption track is explicitly requested and observed in the exact immutable imported source version.

fields.captionTrackRef: Track identity or source location as observed.
fields.language: Observed language tag when available; otherwise UNKNOWN.
fields.format: Observed sidecar format or embedded track encoding when available; otherwise UNKNOWN.

liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.label: Review project
liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.outcome: The result records a comment, approval, rejection, or request for changes for one exact immutable project version, within an explicit purpose and one or more selected review scopes (quality, rights, provenance, or approval), and only under current assigned reviewer authority with an explicit scope and expiry disposition. The review outcome remains linked to that exact version and scope; it does not mutate the reviewed version, clear rights, or authorize external publication. Missing or stale version, scope, purpose, evidence, authority, or expiry disposition leaves the result UNKNOWN or blocks the review.
preconditions: Verified actor/workspace and required delegated authority.

Current owner policy assigns the actor review authority for this exact immutable project version, declared purpose, selected scopes, and expiry; a role label, caller claim, or past approval is insufficient.
Inputs and references are available, validated, rights/consent eligible, and within declared bounds.
Capability, profile, license, policy, resource, and deployment admission are checked at the effect boundary.
constraints: No product default/model/provider is inferred from names, package presence, tests, or source documentation.
Unsupported combinations remain explicit; no silent substitution.

Preserve exact source lineage only for source-derived outputs; source-free authored or generated outputs identify their origin without fabricating a source artifact. Report reconstruction or estimation distinctly from measured/ground-truth output.
rightsPrivacyImplications: Data classification, purpose, consent, locality, residency, egress, retention, training/secondary use, and source/derivative obligations remain independent policy axes.
Minimize sensitive data and retain no provider copy or derived biometric/identity material absent explicit authority.
liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.cancellationRetryReconciliation: Define operation-specific cancellation, retry idempotency, uncertain external outcome, and reconciliation before runtime admission; watching disconnect is not server cancellation.
explicitUnsupportedCases: Any unqualified language, format, size, output dimension, physical/scientific regime, identity/likeness use, provider, license, locality, or profile.
Any unsupported parameter value or combination; do not substitute silently.
Any review action or scope outside the declared finite values, any review detached from its exact immutable project version, or any caller assertion used in place of current assigned authority.

Present translated content as a draft, not as approved or verified text. For an otherwise admitted translation request with a missing or unavailable memory or glossary, explicitly report that it was not applied; do not silently substitute another entry, glossary, or translation behavior. If a supplied memory or glossary is denied, stale, ambiguous, conflicting, or unknown, report that state; if source authorization or rights are denied or unknown, block the operation under the family admission behavior in MEDIA-REQ-CAP-SPEECH-TRANSCRIPTION-AC-02 with no fallback. For any dubbed result, preserve every supplied per-segment speaker, locale, source-timing, and translation-provenance field. If a field is not supplied or cannot be established, identify it as absent or unknown rather than silently omitting or fabricating it; mark a field not applicable only with an explicit reason. This case does not establish audio/video export synchronization, which remains a separate requirement.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject changing a term marked do-not-translate, silently omitting an unresolved protected term, applying an unversioned, unapproved, or inapplicable entry, resolving conflicting entries by silent preference, or describing a translated draft as owner-approved or verified.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized microphone recording session and an admitted transcription request refer to the same exact captured source version.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject implying archive registration, changing either artifact without separate authorization, or claiming a resolved pair when source identity or alignment is unknown.

acceptanceCases.rejection: reject implying that voice conditioning authored, verified, or authorized response text or its claims; reject presenting generated text as a user statement, verified fact, or approved communication.

acceptanceCases.given: A creator requests singing-voice synthesis conditioned on an identifiable voice, source recording, or voice model.
acceptanceCases.when: the product produces a permitted synthesis result.
acceptanceCases.then: retain the declared voice, source, and model provenance with the resulting media.
acceptanceCases.rejection: reject omitting the provenance needed to distinguish the source and model used for the derived voice result.

acceptanceCases.given: A user explicitly starts a full-duplex voice conversation and authorizes a live speech-input session; the streaming transcription and streaming synthesis leaves are separately admitted for the requested scope.
acceptanceCases.when: Media concurrently receives live speech input and prepares or returns a generated spoken response for the current conversational turn.
acceptanceCases.then: provide a response attributable to the current user-initiated turn, distinguish observed or transcribed input from generated response text and synthesized audio, expose whether the turn is still streaming or complete, and preserve interruption and cancellation as explicit outcomes; do not modify a project or publish a response as a separate effect.
acceptanceCases.rejection: reject hidden or background microphone capture, continuing capture after the user ends the session, representing partial or uncertain recognition as confirmed input, or reporting a complete response when the outcome is unknown or unavailable.

acceptanceCases.given: A creator supplies an authorized narration or text source with ordered chapter and paragraph boundaries and requests an audiobook output in a declared M4B profile.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares the requested speech artifact and audiobook package.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve the supplied chapter and paragraph order and boundaries in the audiobook candidate, bind the requested voice and source provenance to that candidate, and expose the requested M4B package and metadata only as candidate properties. If authorization, source/audio/voice/package rights or license, M4B format support, profile admission, or qualification is denied, absent, or unknown, apply MEDIA-REQ-CAP-SPEECH-SYNTHESIS-AC-02; never report the requested format as available on unknown evidence or imply completed delivery.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject flattening or reordering supplied boundaries, inventing chapter metadata, silently substituting a format or voice, or representing candidate metadata as proof of qualified format support, completed audio, or delivery.

acceptanceCases.given: A creator supplies an authorized, rights-cleared source, ordered text segments, and an authorized, rights-cleared, admitted voice/personality profile with the exact shared context intended to govern their synthesis.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares speech for those segments as one continuous work.
acceptanceCases.then: Represent the declared segment order and shared context/profile as requested candidate properties; report continuity as established only for segments where the admitted operation establishes it, and expose other segments as denied, unsupported, or unknown. Apply MEDIA-REQ-CAP-SPEECH-SYNTHESIS-AC-02 if source, voice, profile, authorization, rights, or license admission is denied, absent, or unknown; a candidate property does not guarantee audible continuity.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming cross-segment continuity from unrelated or missing context, silently changing the declared profile, or treating an unavailable or unknown continuity result as established or guaranteeing audible identity/continuity.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator supplies an ordered story or speech plan with explicit segment boundaries and an authorized speaker assignment for each segment.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares or generates speech for the ordered segments.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve segment order and boundaries, bind each segment to its exact authorized speaker and applicable rights evidence, and return per-segment voice, source, and generated-audio provenance with any unavailable assignment marked explicitly.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject using a speaker without current authorization for the segment and purpose, silently substituting a voice or reordering segments, or claiming a generated artifact is committed when it is only a candidate.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized synthesis request pins the exact requested speaker or voice, model/checkpoint, profile, worker, and source version for the declared purpose.
acceptanceCases.when: Media returns a generated-audio candidate or execution observation.
acceptanceCases.then: Report requested and observed speaker/voice, model/checkpoint, profile, worker, and source identities separately for the exact output; preserve mismatch or unobserved identity as UNKNOWN and retain the output as synthetic media.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting a speaker, voice, model, checkpoint, profile, or worker; inferring the effective identity from the request alone; or treating a configured identity as proof of the output's authorship, rights, or authenticity.

acceptanceCases.rejection: reject hidden or background microphone capture, continuing capture after the user ends the session, representing partial or uncertain recognition as confirmed input, or reporting a complete response when the outcome is unknown or unavailable.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject flattening or reordering supplied boundaries, inventing chapter metadata, silently substituting a format or voice, or representing candidate metadata as proof of qualified format support, completed audio, or delivery.

acceptanceCases.given: A creator supplies an authorized, rights-cleared source, ordered text segments, and an authorized, rights-cleared, admitted voice/personality profile with the exact shared context intended to govern their synthesis.

acceptanceCases.then: Represent the declared segment order and shared context/profile as requested candidate properties; report continuity as established only for segments where the admitted operation establishes it, and expose other segments as denied, unsupported, or unknown. acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming cross-segment continuity from unrelated or missing context, silently changing the declared profile, or treating an unavailable or unknown continuity result as established or guaranteeing audible identity/continuity.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting a speaker, voice, model, checkpoint, profile, or worker; inferring the effective identity from the request alone; or treating a configured identity as proof of the output's authorship, rights, or authenticity.

liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.label: Create reusable composition
liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.outcome: Produce a local reviewable reusable composition candidate from selected project assets. The candidate may include editable branded motion-template bindings whose brand assets and motion parameters are typed and traceable to exact selected sources, or a versioned reusable audio-effects-chain candidate scoped to an exact voice track. An audio chain binds selected existing master-audio effects and exact chain version/provenance to that track; it does not infer speaker identity or imply speech enhancement. Preserve unsupported or unresolved bindings explicitly; a candidate does not establish preview/render parity, project commit, or rendered delivery.

acceptanceCases.given: An actor requests an active-speaker-aware multicamera cut proposal from admitted speaker-turn and camera-source observations.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the proposal.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects exact audio-track versions and declares gain, pan, and time-varying automation points with a timebase and project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the multitrack edit.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a local reviewable candidate that preserves track and source-version identities, records the requested automation points and any validation uncertainty, and leaves project state unchanged until explicit confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject collapsing automation to an undocumented static value, mutating the project or source audio before confirmation, or implying a rendered output from the candidate.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects an exact speech source version and specifies a sample-time region edit, including intended boundaries and any crossfade parameters.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the speech edit against the declared sample rate and timebase.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable local candidate with exact source-version and sample-boundary references, disclose boundary quantization or crossfade validation uncertainty, and preserve the source and project revision.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently shifting boundaries, inventing crossfade values, modifying the source, or claiming the candidate has been rendered or committed.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor requests overlay placement in apparent free space for an exact source version and time interval.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates detected free-space evidence and prepares a placement suggestion.
acceptanceCases.then: Return an uncertain local placement candidate tied to the exact source version, time range, declared overlay, and detection context, preserving the evidence and allowing review before any composition change.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject presenting detected free space as guaranteed safe or unobstructed, omitting uncertainty or source-time context, or applying or rendering the placement without explicit authorization.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator selects a branded motion template and supplies typed editable parameters bound to identified brand assets and a project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: The product instantiates the template as a composition proposal.
acceptanceCases.then: Return an editable local candidate that identifies the template version, each typed parameter and its binding, exact source and brand-asset versions, and unresolved parameter constraints; leave the project unchanged pending review and confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting brand assets or parameter values, claiming preview or render parity without evidence, or committing the proposal before confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor has a take intent classified as captured ADR, generated narration, or captured or generated room tone, with exact source or session provenance and a declared timeline location.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares placement in the multitrack composition.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable local placement candidate that preserves the content-origin distinction, exact source or generation provenance, intended time range, and any alignment uncertainty without mutating the project.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject relabeling generated narration as captured ADR, treating a recording intent as captured content, conflating captured and generated room tone, or committing or rendering the edit without explicit authorization.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor declares protected text or logo regions on an exact source version, or detection evidence for those regions is uncertain.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares an overlay or reframe candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve declared protected regions or mark the candidate unresolved for review, retaining source-version and time-range evidence.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming protected content is preserved when region evidence is absent or uncertain, changing the source, or committing the candidate without confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor declares a target aspect ratio, exact source version, time range, and eligible subject evidence for automatic framing.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares a subject-aware framing candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Bind the candidate to the declared target and source-time evidence and disclose uncertainty and any crop or excluded source region.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming all subjects or content remain in frame when evidence is uncertain, silently changing aspect ratio, or modifying or rendering the source without confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects exact track versions and declares track-to-bus assignments, send routing, pre/post-fader position, and any bus or track effect-chain version for one project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares the multitrack routing candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a local, reviewable routing graph that preserves the declared assignments, routing, gain/pan/automation, effect-chain identities, and source versions and exposes unresolved compatibility; leave the project and audio unchanged pending explicit confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferred routing or effect values, cycles or unsupported graphs, silent track/bus substitution, source mutation, project commit, rendering, export, or qualified loudness/true-peak claims.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject a missing or inaccessible source manifest, silent parameter substitution, treating reuse as reproducibility or admission, or implying that the prior output was regenerated.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator submits a generation request with explicit shot intervals, per-shot prompt overrides, optional rights-cleared masks, region trajectories or motion-brush conditions, and timeline/keyframe anchors bound to an exact source version and timebase.

acceptanceCases.then: Bind each prompt, mask, region trajectory, motion-brush condition, and anchor to its declared shot/time range, region identity, source version, and timebase; report applied, unsupported, estimated, or unknown constraints per shot and distinguish generated conditions from authored or observed scene facts.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject invalid ranges or unresolved conflicting overlaps without an explicit precedence policy, masks without required rights, silently applying shot instructions to the whole clip, or claiming unsupported controls were honored; unknown support, region/time mapping, or rights blocks the affected scope.

acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares a candidate recast or altered-presenter output.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject treating disclosure as authorization, inferring identity or rights from a reference alone, replacing the source silently, or claiming a generated result is product-action proof.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator requests joint audio-video generation and declares exact input identities, intended audio/video relation, source timebase, and output profile.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting either modality or inferring synchronized output when the relation or observation is absent, unsupported, or unknown.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator requests generated dialogue or sound effects related to lip motion and declares exact source versions, intended time relation, and timebase.

acceptanceCases.when: The caller requests the operation.
acceptanceCases.then: The typed result, effective parameters, provenance, terminal/finality state, and measured dimensions are returned; only the declared effect occurs.

acceptanceCases.given: The requested language, format, right, profile, license, capability, or qualification is absent or unknown.
acceptanceCases.when: Admission is evaluated.
acceptanceCases.then: The operation is blocked or returns an explicit qualified fallback only when policy permits; unknown is never reported as available.

acceptanceCases.given: An actor is authorized to search transcript content for an exact source-media or project version.
acceptanceCases.when: The actor requests a semantic transcript search.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded candidate matches anchored to the exact source version and transcript time range; distinguish unavailable transcript content, denied scope, unknown matching, and an empty candidate page.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject presenting candidates as complete when matching or continuation is unknown, or returning transcript content outside the admitted rights-and-retention scope.

acceptanceCases.given: An actor is authorized to inspect possible duplicate or near-duplicate artifacts.
acceptanceCases.when: the actor requests duplicate detection.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded candidate groups that retain every source artifact identity and state the matching uncertainty.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject merging, replacing, or deleting any source artifact as a consequence of candidate detection.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized Studio creator searches the governed Media asset store for candidates for an explicitly declared intended-use scope.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates each immutable asset version for the requested license/use-scope filter.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a candidate as eligible only when current authoritative per-version rights and license evidence explicitly permits the declared scope; preserve the exact asset version and evidence identity. Missing, unknown, denied, expired, revoked, restricted, or incompatible evidence never makes a candidate eligible, and unresolved evidence is reported as UNKNOWN or review-required rather than as an empty eligible result.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferring permission from searchable metadata, treating this filter as legal clearance, silently substituting a different asset or license, or claiming external-catalog search, ranking, or complete results.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor searches an admitted project for timeline, person, scene, or speaker facets with an explicit time range and exact project or source-version scope.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates the requested facet filters against indexed observations.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded matches with exact immutable source-version references, matching time ranges, and observed or inferred provenance; report unknown or unindexed fields and partial matching separately from a known empty result.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject presenting an unindexed or uncertain facet as absent, claiming complete matches while continuation or indexing is unknown, or widening the search beyond authorized rights and retention scope.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator submits a visual or descriptive metadata query for assets within an explicit project and version scope.
acceptanceCases.when: The product searches available visual observations and metadata.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded candidate matches with exact source-version provenance, relevant time ranges where available, and match uncertainty; distinguish unavailable or unindexed evidence and unknown matching from a known empty result.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject representing similarity as a verified fact, dropping source-version provenance, claiming completeness when indexing or continuation is unknown, or exposing content outside admitted rights and retention scope.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor imports a sidecar or embedded caption track for an exact immutable media version and the format and rights are admitted.
acceptanceCases.when: The product parses and validates the caption source and its timebase mapping.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable caption-import result preserving source-file provenance, source version, language and format when known, caption timing, and any conversion or alignment uncertainty; do not alter the source media.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently shifting or dropping caption timing, claiming unknown language or alignment as verified, or registering or replacing a canonical artifact without the separately authorized action.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor requests a clip derived from an exact immutable source version with an explicit source-time range, output profile, purpose, and applicable rights.
acceptanceCases.when: The product validates the range against the source timebase and prepares the derivation.
acceptanceCases.then: Bind the candidate derivation to the exact source version and requested start and end times, disclose boundary quantization or uncertainty, and return job or candidate state without changing the source.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject substituting another source version, silently rounding or extending the requested range, implying a completed or registered artifact before that state is confirmed, or bypassing rights and profile admission.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized user searches the governed Media asset store by declared metadata and an intended-use rights scope.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates exact asset versions against available metadata and authoritative per-version rights evidence.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded candidates with exact version and rights-evidence references; distinguish unknown or incomplete indexing from a known empty result. External catalogs are available only when a specific catalog and use are separately admitted.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferring permission from searchable metadata, calling search legal clearance, or claiming external-catalog, complete, or ranked results when those scopes are not admitted.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor supplies a source timecode with its exact source version, declared frame rate or timebase, and drop-frame or non-drop-frame mode.
acceptanceCases.when: The product interprets or converts that timecode.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve the original label and mode and return an exact source-time mapping only when the declared rate, mode, and mapping are valid.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject ambiguous or invalid labels, mismatched rates, unknown mappings, silent drop-frame/non-drop-frame reinterpretation, or rounding across frame boundaries.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently shifting or dropping captions, changing the target media version or format, claiming destination acceptance before it is observed, or embedding or exporting without authorization.

acceptanceCases.when: Media submits a governed publication request and observes any remote result.
acceptanceCases.then: Distinguish Media request acceptance, destination acknowledgment, confirmed delivery, and audience access, binding each observed state to its source and reference.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject reporting a local request acknowledgment or unknown remote state as destination completion or audience access.

acceptanceCases.given: An actor requests an active-speaker-aware multicamera cut proposal from admitted speaker-turn and camera-source observations.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the proposal.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable local candidate that links each proposed cut to its speaker-turn and camera-source evidence and makes uncertainty explicit.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferring missing speaker/camera evidence or committing the proposal to the project without an explicit separate approval.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects exact audio-track versions and declares gain, pan, and time-varying automation points with a timebase and project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the multitrack edit.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a local reviewable candidate that preserves track and source-version identities, records the requested automation points and any validation uncertainty, and leaves project state unchanged until explicit confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject collapsing automation to an undocumented static value, mutating the project or source audio before confirmation, or implying a rendered output from the candidate.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects an exact speech source version and specifies a sample-time region edit, including intended boundaries and any crossfade parameters.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the speech edit against the declared sample rate and timebase.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable local candidate with exact source-version and sample-boundary references, disclose boundary quantization or crossfade validation uncertainty, and preserve the source and project revision.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently shifting boundaries, inventing crossfade values, modifying the source, or claiming the candidate has been rendered or committed.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor requests overlay placement in apparent free space for an exact source version and time interval.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates detected free-space evidence and prepares a placement suggestion.
acceptanceCases.then: Return an uncertain local placement candidate tied to the exact source version, time range, declared overlay, and detection context, preserving the evidence and allowing review before any composition change.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject presenting detected free space as guaranteed safe or unobstructed, omitting uncertainty or source-time context, or applying or rendering the placement without explicit authorization.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator selects a branded motion template and supplies typed editable parameters bound to identified brand assets and a project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: The product instantiates the template as a composition proposal.
acceptanceCases.then: Return an editable local candidate that identifies the template version, each typed parameter and its binding, exact source and brand-asset versions, and unresolved parameter constraints; leave the project unchanged pending review and confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting brand assets or parameter values, claiming preview or render parity without evidence, or committing the proposal before confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor has a take intent classified as captured ADR, generated narration, or captured or generated room tone, with exact source or session provenance and a declared timeline location.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares placement in the multitrack composition.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable local placement candidate that preserves the content-origin distinction, exact source or generation provenance, intended time range, and any alignment uncertainty without mutating the project.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject relabeling generated narration as captured ADR, treating a recording intent as captured content, conflating captured and generated room tone, or committing or rendering the edit without explicit authorization.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor declares protected text or logo regions on an exact source version, or detection evidence for those regions is uncertain.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares an overlay or reframe candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve declared protected regions or mark the candidate unresolved for review, retaining source-version and time-range evidence.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming protected content is preserved when region evidence is absent or uncertain, changing the source, or committing the candidate without confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor declares a target aspect ratio, exact source version, time range, and eligible subject evidence for automatic framing.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares a subject-aware framing candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Bind the candidate to the declared target and source-time evidence and disclose uncertainty and any crop or excluded source region.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming all subjects or content remain in frame when evidence is uncertain, silently changing aspect ratio, or modifying or rendering the source without confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects exact track versions and declares track-to-bus assignments, send routing, pre/post-fader position, and any bus or track effect-chain version for one project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares the multitrack routing candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a local, reviewable routing graph that preserves the declared assignments, routing, gain/pan/automation, effect-chain identities, and source versions and exposes unresolved compatibility; leave the project and audio unchanged pending explicit confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferred routing or effect values, cycles or unsupported graphs, silent track/bus substitution, source mutation, project commit, rendering, export, or qualified loudness/true-peak claims.

liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.label: Import artifact
liveCapabilityAndCaseSnapshot.outcome: Resolve an admitted source reference or staged upload and report a governed import observation. Create a governed artifact version only after source authority, integrity, and owner-confirmed registration requirements are satisfied. Unknown source, mapping, or registration remains unknown.

optionalSemanticObservations.when: An authorized sidecar or embedded caption track is explicitly requested and observed in the exact immutable imported source version.

fields.captionTrackRef: Track identity or source location as observed.
fields.language: Observed language tag when available; otherwise UNKNOWN.
fields.format: Observed sidecar format or embedded track encoding when available; otherwise UNKNOWN.
fields.timingMapping: Declared source timebase, any explicit mapping applied, and conversion or alignment uncertainty.
fields.provenance: Whether the track was observed embedded or supplied as an authorized sidecar.

constraints: Observation does not alter source media, register or replace a canonical artifact, or claim caption correctness.
Missing, malformed, or unknown track mapping remains explicit.

preconditions: The source reference is resolvable under current actor, tenant, workspace, and source-system authority.
The source is permitted for the requested import purpose and locality; external fetch/egress behavior is explicitly authorized.
The target workspace and optional project are authorized; artifact integrity and retention rules are defined by the owning service.
constraints: Import is not upload: an external source reference may resolve to bytes or an existing immutable artifact according to the owner contract.
Resolution never bypasses source-system permission, policy, locality, or retention requirements.
No artifact is reported available until verification and registration are confirmed.
Existing source identity and resulting artifact version are recorded separately with provenance.
rightsPrivacyImplications: Data classification, purpose, consent, locality, residency, egress, retention, training/secondary use, and source/derivative obligations remain independent policy axes.
Minimize sensitive data and retain no provider copy or derived biometric/identity material absent explicit authority.

explicitUnsupportedCases: Importing from arbitrary URLs or untrusted remote sources without owner-defined allowlists, SSRF controls, locality, and egress policy.
Treating successful source resolution as integrity verification, project attachment, or rights clearance.

acceptanceCases.given: The source reference is resolvable and permitted for this target and purpose.
acceptanceCases.when: The actor requests import.
acceptanceCases.then: The result distinguishes source resolution, byte transfer if any, verification, and artifact-version registration, and records source lineage.

acceptanceCases.given: The source is denied, missing, expired, unsupported, or has unknown rights.
acceptanceCases.when: The actor requests import.
acceptanceCases.then: The operation blocks with a stable reason; no inaccessible source is fetched and no artifact is created.

acceptanceCases.given: An actor is authorized to search transcript content for an exact source-media or project version.
acceptanceCases.when: The actor requests a semantic transcript search.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded candidate matches anchored to the exact source version and transcript time range; distinguish unavailable transcript content, denied scope, unknown matching, and an empty candidate page.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject presenting candidates as complete when matching or continuation is unknown, or returning transcript content outside the admitted rights-and-retention scope.

acceptanceCases.given: An actor is authorized to inspect possible duplicate or near-duplicate artifacts.
acceptanceCases.when: the actor requests duplicate detection.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded candidate groups that retain every source artifact identity and state the matching uncertainty.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject merging, replacing, or deleting any source artifact as a consequence of candidate detection.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized Studio creator searches the governed Media asset store for candidates for an explicitly declared intended-use scope.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates each immutable asset version for the requested license/use-scope filter.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a candidate as eligible only when current authoritative per-version rights and license evidence explicitly permits the declared scope; preserve the exact asset version and evidence identity. Missing, unknown, denied, expired, revoked, restricted, or incompatible evidence never makes a candidate eligible, and unresolved evidence is reported as UNKNOWN or review-required rather than as an empty eligible result.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferring permission from searchable metadata, treating this filter as legal clearance, silently substituting a different asset or license, or claiming external-catalog search, ranking, or complete results.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor searches an admitted project for timeline, person, scene, or speaker facets with an explicit time range and exact project or source-version scope.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates the requested facet filters against indexed observations.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded matches with exact immutable source-version references, matching time ranges, and observed or inferred provenance; report unknown or unindexed fields and partial matching separately from a known empty result.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject presenting an unindexed or uncertain facet as absent, claiming complete matches while continuation or indexing is unknown, or widening the search beyond authorized rights and retention scope.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator submits a visual or descriptive metadata query for assets within an explicit project and version scope.
acceptanceCases.when: The product searches available visual observations and metadata.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded candidate matches with exact source-version provenance, relevant time ranges where available, and match uncertainty; distinguish unavailable or unindexed evidence and unknown matching from a known empty result.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject representing similarity as a verified fact, dropping source-version provenance, claiming completeness when indexing or continuation is unknown, or exposing content outside admitted rights and retention scope.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor imports a sidecar or embedded caption track for an exact immutable media version and the format and rights are admitted.
acceptanceCases.when: The product parses and validates the caption source and its timebase mapping.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable caption-import result preserving source-file provenance, source version, language and format when known, caption timing, and any conversion or alignment uncertainty; do not alter the source media.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently shifting or dropping caption timing, claiming unknown language or alignment as verified, or registering or replacing a canonical artifact without the separately authorized action.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor requests a clip derived from an exact immutable source version with an explicit source-time range, output profile, purpose, and applicable rights.
acceptanceCases.when: The product validates the range against the source timebase and prepares the derivation.
acceptanceCases.then: Bind the candidate derivation to the exact source version and requested start and end times, disclose boundary quantization or uncertainty, and return job or candidate state without changing the source.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject substituting another source version, silently rounding or extending the requested range, implying a completed or registered artifact before that state is confirmed, or bypassing rights and profile admission.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized user searches the governed Media asset store by declared metadata and an intended-use rights scope.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates exact asset versions against available metadata and authoritative per-version rights evidence.
acceptanceCases.then: Return bounded candidates with exact version and rights-evidence references; distinguish unknown or incomplete indexing from a known empty result. External catalogs are available only when a specific catalog and use are separately admitted.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferring permission from searchable metadata, calling search legal clearance, or claiming external-catalog, complete, or ranked results when those scopes are not admitted.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor supplies a source timecode with its exact source version, declared frame rate or timebase, and drop-frame or non-drop-frame mode.
acceptanceCases.when: The product interprets or converts that timecode.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve the original label and mode and return an exact source-time mapping only when the declared rate, mode, and mapping are valid.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject ambiguous or invalid labels, mismatched rates, unknown mappings, silent drop-frame/non-drop-frame reinterpretation, or rounding across frame boundaries.
